English.Char_Desc_450: MacClean is a native macOS utility that helps reclaim disk space. Review WeChat, QQ and WeCom media by type, explore Storage Map and System Data, clean Xcode DerivedData and local AI model caches, find duplicates, and uninstall apps with leftover review. Free (no charge). Ordinary cleanup goes to Trash first. Not notarized — Gatekeeper may warn.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
MacClean is a native macOS disk cleaner focused on real storage clutter: WeChat/QQ/WeCom media, Storage Map / System Data analysis, Xcode and developer caches, local AI models, duplicate files, and app uninstall leftovers.
Features: - Chat media cleanup for WeChat, QQ and WeCom (review before remove) - Storage Map to understand large folders and System Data - Developer Tools: Xcode DerivedData, npm/pip/Gradle caches, Ollama/Hugging Face/LM Studio models - App manager with leftover review - Duplicate files and similar photos - Menu bar status (disk, memory, battery, network) - Ordinary cleanup moves files to Trash so you can restore from Cleanup History
Pricing: Free / no charge. Not Apple-notarized yet — first open may need Control-click Open / Open Anyway.
Download DMG from https://thulem.com/ (Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 14+).

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: You may distribute MacClean via download directories and review sites with the official DMG link unchanged. Do not rehost modified binaries.
